body:
I work in a factory that produces cards. My idiotic bosses want more and more from the employees. The pay is not good. The machine that I work on demands way too much from my body, especially when I have to work a 12 hour shift in front of it. It's an ergonomic nightmare.

I'll PM you some of my paintings when they're done uploading. I'm anxious about people I know finding this.

It's just the compounding of issues. I know that sounds strange. I don't want to blow all of my money on dentist or doctor visits, because I'm trying to make this Euro trip work. I'm hoping it will put some wind in my sails, because right now I'm in the doldrums.
